news.headline: Piper Sandler reaffirms Buy on Nektar as analysts lift price target toward $153
news.summary: Following Q2 results, Piper Sandler reiterated its Buy rating and analysts collectively raised their consensus price target on NKTR to roughly $153, citing confidence in the rezpegaldesleukin Phase 3 program despite continued losses.

news.headline: Nektar beats Q2 2026 EPS but stock slips after hours
news.summary: On the earnings call, CEO Howard Robin called 2026 a "transformative year" for Nektar, reiterating a first BLA submission target of 2029 for rezpegaldesleukin and plans to start a Phase 3 alopecia areata trial in early 2027; shares fell after hours despite the EPS beat.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Nektar reported Q2 revenue of $10.1 million and a net loss of $1.23 per share (versus a $2.00 loss estimate), with cash and investments swelling to $1,023.4 million as of June 30, 2026, up from $245.8 million at year-end 2025.

news.headline: Canaccord Genuity initiates coverage on Nektar at Buy with $153 price target
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity Group began coverage of NKTR with a Buy rating and a $153 price target, joining a bullish analyst consensus ahead of the Phase 3 readouts.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program
news.summary: Nektar initiated the first two global registrational Phase 3 trials, ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2, evaluating rezpegaldesleukin in patients 12 and older with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis; a third trial, ZENITH AD-3, is set to begin in September, with about 1,530 patients enrolling worldwide across the program.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Reports Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Nektar's board granted non-qualified stock options for an aggregate of 36,000 shares to 23 newly-hired employees under the company's 2025 Inducement Plan, reflecting continued hiring as the Phase 3 program ramps up.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 trial start
catalysts.detail: Third Phase 3 trial in the ZENITH AD program, enrolling atopic dermatitis patients with prior biologic/JAK-inhibitor treatment experience, expected to begin enrolling around 510 additional patients.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata trial start
catalysts.detail: Nektar plans to initiate a single registrational Phase 3 trial of rezpegaldesleukin in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata, building on positive REZOLVE-AA Phase 2b data.

catalysts.label: TrialNet Type 1 diabetes Phase 2 data
catalysts.detail: Initial data expected from the TrialNet-sponsored Phase 2 study of rezpegaldesleukin in new-onset Stage 3 Type 1 diabetes.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline data
catalysts.detail: Initial topline readout from the ZENITH AD-1/AD-2 registrational trials in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis.

catalysts.label: First BLA submission for rezpegaldesleukin
catalysts.detail: Company-stated target for filing the first Biologics License Application, in atopic dermatitis, pending positive Phase 3 results.

catalysts.label: Next quarterly earnings report
catalysts.detail: Nektar's third-quarter 2026 financial results and pipeline update, timing to be confirmed closer to the date.

pulse: Nektar is in full Phase 3 execution mode for rezpegaldesleukin, having launched the first two ZENITH AD atopic-dermatitis trials in July with a third to start in September, while a Phase 3 alopecia areata study is slated for early 2027 and a first BLA is targeted for 2029. Q2 2026 results (reported August 13) showed a narrower-than-expected loss and a cash position bolstered past $1 billion by prior equity raises, and while shares dipped after hours on the print, analysts including Canaccord Genuity and Piper Sandler have grown more bullish, pushing consensus price targets toward $153. NKTR trades well below those targets, reflecting a stock still priced for binary Phase 3 risk over the next two-plus years before pivotal data arrives.
